description: This Java class 'PcChargeApi' provides an API for constructing, sending, and processing XML-based communication with a third-party payment processing system. It manages XML request/response documents, network socket communication, and defines constants for various transaction fields.

classes.name: PcChargeApi
classes.description: A class for creating, sending, and parsing XML-based API requests to a third-party payment processor, supporting socket communication and XML document management.
